study: Decision Value of Training Evidence: Reanalysis of the National Supported Work Experiment
finding: The observed randomized difference in 1978 earnings is $1,794.34. A seeded nonparametric bootstrap gives a 95% resampling interval of about $501–$3,097. Only 36% of bootstrap resamples exceed a $2,000 minimum-gain threshold; this is a bootstrap exceedance fraction, not a Bayesian posterior probability.
source: National Supported Work Demonstration — Dehejia-Wahba experimental sample
